title: Cartwise Shopper Payouts — Amount of an Instant Cashout onto the Everyday Pay Card
content:
**Clause.** Under Cartwise Shopper Payouts, an instant cashout onto the Everyday Pay Card carries the balance on the account less the tips posted on the batch that is completed but not yet finalized, limited to the card plan's per-transaction maximum and to what remains of its daily maximum after the day's earlier cashouts, rounded to the cent, and card plans book its fee entry at 0.00.

## Terms used in this clause

- **The balance on the account** — the unpaid earnings balance shown on the shopper's payout account at the time of the cashout.
- **The tips posted on the batch that is completed but not yet finalized** — the total of the tip entries that Cartwise Shopper Batches records on the shopper's batch whose status is completed and which has not yet been finalized.
- **The card plan's per-transaction maximum** — the largest single instant cashout of the Everyday Pay Card plan the account is on, as shown in that plan's cashout limits.
- **What remains of its daily maximum** — the card plan's daily maximum for instant cashouts, less the total of the instant cashout entries already booked on the account on the same calendar day.

## How the amount is formed

The amount loaded onto the card is the smallest of three figures:

1. the card plan's per-transaction maximum;
2. the card plan's daily maximum less the total of that day's earlier instant cashouts;
3. the balance on the account less the tips posted on the completed but not yet finalized batch.

The smallest of the three is never taken below zero, and it is rounded to the cent once, on that final figure. The cashout fee entry that accompanies the cashout is booked at 0.00.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

The figures below are hypothetical inputs chosen to show the clause; the per-transaction and daily maximums are illustrative, not any plan's actual limits.

| Input | Case A | Case B |
|---|---|---|
| Balance on the account | 420.00 | 420.00 |
| Tips on the completed, not yet finalized batch | 18.40 | 18.40 |
| Plan's per-transaction maximum (hypothetical) | 600.00 | 600.00 |
| Plan's daily maximum (hypothetical) | 900.00 | 900.00 |
| Instant cashouts already booked that day | none | 850.00 |
| Balance less the tips | 401.60 | 401.60 |
| Rest of the daily maximum | 900.00 | 50.00 |
| **Amount loaded onto the card** | **401.60** | **50.00** |
| Fee entry | 0.00 | 0.00 |

In Case A the balance less the tips is the smallest figure; in Case B the rest of the daily maximum is. Where the day's earlier cashouts have already used the whole daily maximum, the rest of the daily maximum is zero and the amount is 0.00.

## Points of judgement

- *Which day counts for the daily maximum?* The calendar day of the cashout; only instant cashout entries dated that day reduce what remains.
- *When is the amount rounded?* Only once, on the final figure; the intermediate figures are carried unrounded.
- *What fee is booked?* A fee entry of 0.00 on every card-plan cashout.
